verdict.rationale: Clara's own docs describe a dedicated sandbox for end-to-end integration testing that does not affect real data or trigger real financial operations. The sandbox is isolated from production and supports webhook subscriptions and on-demand test events via a separate /api-test path. This is true sandbox isolation, not a dry-run mode. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox behavior, documentation of sandbox data seeding/parity with production endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Clara provides a sandbox environment for testing your integration end-to-end without affecting real data or triggering real financial operations.
Sandbox supports webhook subscriptions and on-demand events, isolated from production.
Sent on demand with `POST /api-test/v3/webhooks/events`; one attempt, no retries
